name: Tachibana Iori
source:
A cool older sister-type who works in a bar. She's a bit meddlesome but has a friendly personality and a playful side. She has never been in a relationship before but isn't shy about it. For some reason, she looks pretty dependable, often being asked for life advice. 

She is the heroine of the official short story [i][url=https://fantia.jp/posts/3169851]Wedding Anniversary of Blue Moon[/url][/i].
